summary: config Load consults tryLoadCachedZoomToken() so cached S2S OAuth tokens resolve as credentials for cloud commands.
reason: The generator has no credential-resolver hook, so generated config loading only reads env vars and stored config fields; without this fallback the token minted by `auth s2s-token` is cached but never used.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood (--live --level full) passed 388 commands with 0 failures against the real Zoom API using only the cached S2S token.
